cases.case: Eight audio lanes and independent source selection
cases.risk: A source change could redirect a neighboring lane
cases.how: Native MKII wide pair against independent stock composite and T2-only slice
cases.result: Pass. All 624 events, 608 relative writes and 219 states matched. The separate T2 slice matched 384 calls and 400 writes at wrap 90.

cases.risk: Pending state could appear too late
cases.result: Fail. Requested by tick 89 +1 ms, pending diagnostic still zero at +15 ms, committed at wrap 90 +16 ms.

cases.risk: Restore could be reported on the wrong tick
cases.how: Native late pair and strict boundary grader
cases.result: Fail. All 848 events, 816 writes and 298 states matched, but pending restore appeared at tick 187; the oracle requires 188.

cases.case: ARR after stock popup during Row Edit
cases.risk: Editor could keep the panel hidden or lose a row
cases.how: Native popup fixture and host callback test
cases.result: Pass. ARR reopened, R04 retained its definition and OFF recovered the full pool.

cases.case: Unrelated bank, early EOF, popup during bank load
cases.risk: An already-defined R04 could be cleared
cases.how: Host callbacks with an actual temporary-file EOF and an unrelated bank mask
cases.result: Pass. R04 and its source survive.

cases.risk: Destination initialization can clear the previous rows before completion
cases.how: Host late-failure case with a short read after init
cases.result: Fail. The characterization test passes by reproducing loss of R04. Native late-abort recovery remains unverified.

cases.risk: Rows could be kept or discarded for the wrong destination
cases.how: Stock PROJECT menu in native emulator on disposable cards
cases.result: Pass. Missing stored files preserved bank A and R04. Completed stored reload selected bank B and cleared R04. OFF recovered the full pool in both cases.

cases.risk: Queued source changes or handlers could survive removal
cases.how: T2 slice and Arranger recovery fixtures
cases.result: Pass. STOP cancelled the queued change; OFF restored callback heads and all 786432 pool bytes. Stock Arranger playback matched before and after removal.

cases.risk: Panel, source or wrap registration could conflict with base owners
cases.how: Candidate build by named hooks, callback heads before/after OFF and upstream-only compile
cases.result: Pass on the candidate for bindings and T2 unload. Blocked on upstream main for the three proposed bindings; catalogue-only compatibility excludes CLYPS.

cases.risk: Audio, cost, USB trial and persistence require the real instrument
cases.result: Not run. Trial, soak, pricing, rollback and inventory, MAIN/CUE listening and persistence remain open.
